papers.title: Verix: a toolkit for benchmarking and harmonization of complex structural variants
papers.summary: Abstract Summary Complex structural variants (CSVs) represent a critical yet under-characterized class of large-scale genomic rearrangements. CSV discovery requires not only the accurate detection of individual breakpoints but also their assembly into a single, structurally resolved CSV event. However, CSV method development is currently limited by a diagnostic gap: existing SV evaluation frameworks are designed for single-interval or single-junction SVs and cannot quantify multi-breakpoint CSV reconstruction fidelity or systematically distinguish between different types of reconstruction errors, such as over-segmentation or collapse of independent breakpoints. Here we present Verix, a comprehensive toolkit designed for the fine-grained evaluation and integration of CSVs. Verixintroduces granular diagnostic metrics that enable researchers to thoroughly characterize CSV predictions and stratify performance based on breakpoint sensitivity, precision, and structural integrity. In addition to pairwise callset-to-truthset comparisons, Verixalso provides an intra- and inter-callset harmonization module for generating consensus calls for a single tool’s output or across disparate discovery pipelines. As such, Verixprovides the infrastructure needed to rigorously evaluate and reconcile CSV calls, accelerating the standardization of CSV discovery in both research and clinical settings. Availability and implementation Verixis available under the MIT license at https://github.com/PopicLab/verix and https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22998063

papers.title: PRIDA: Cross-domain protein-RNA interaction prediction based on biological language models and conditional domain-adversarial learning
papers.summary: Abstract Motivation The interaction between RNA and proteins is a complex process that involves atom-level details and dynamic changes. Accurate prediction of protein-RNA interactions helps researchers to develop protein-targeted small nucleic acid drugs. However, the scarcity of protein-RNA complexes and experimental data limits the ability of existing data-driven supervised learning methods to learn latent patterns, leading to limited performance. Results In this study, we propose PRIDA ( P rotein- R NA I nteraction prediction based on D omain- A dversarial learning), a protein-RNA interaction framework that combines bilinear attention with conditional domain-adversarial learning. Powered by pretrained protein and RNA language models, PRIDA improves interaction prediction under protein-level distribution shifts and limited labeled data. By integrating PRIDA with Monte Carlo Tree Search, we apply it to a virtual screening pipeline to generate RNA aptamer candidates for specific target proteins. Experimental results show that PRIDA achieves state-of-the-art performance in cross-domain protein-RNA interaction prediction and provides effective guidance for RNA aptamer virtual screening. Availability The data and source code of the proposed method are available at GitHub ( https://github.com/zhouyyang/PRIDA ) and Zenodo ( https://zenodo.org/records/23644677 )

papers.llm_rss_summary_zh:
**摘要**  
RNA与蛋白质之间的相互作用是一个复杂的过程，其中涉及原子级别的细节及动态变化。准确预测这种相互作用有助于研究人员开发针对特定蛋白质的小分子核酸药物。然而，由于蛋白质-RNA复合物及其相关实验数据的稀缺性，现有的数据驱动监督学习方法在挖掘潜在规律方面存在局限性，从而导致其预测性能不佳。  

**研究结果**

**结果**：在本研究中，我们提出了PRIDA这一基于领域对抗学习的蛋白质-RNA相互作用预测框架。该框架将双线性注意力机制与条件领域的对抗学习相结合，并依托预训练的蛋白质及RNA语言模型，在蛋白质结构发生微小变化或标签数据有限的情况下显著提升了预测精度。通过将PRIDA与蒙特卡洛树搜索算法结合，我们将其应用于虚拟筛选流程中，成功为特定目标蛋白质生成了候选RNA适配体。实验结果表明，PRIDA在跨领域蛋白质-RNA相互作用预测方面取得了领先性能，为RNA适配体的虚拟筛选工作提供了有效指导。  

**数据与代码获取**：所提出方法的相关数据及源代码可分别在GitHub（https://github.com/zhouyyang/PRIDA）和Zenodo（https://zenodo.org/records/23644677）上获取。  

**补充信息**：更多补充数据可在线查阅Bioinformatics相关资源。

all_papers.title: Verix: a toolkit for benchmarking and harmonization of complex structural variants
all_papers.summary: Abstract Summary Complex structural variants (CSVs) represent a critical yet under-characterized class of large-scale genomic rearrangements. CSV discovery requires not only the accurate detection of individual breakpoints but also their assembly into a single, structurally resolved CSV event. However, CSV method development is currently limited by a diagnostic gap: existing SV evaluation frameworks are designed for single-interval or single-junction SVs and cannot quantify multi-breakpoint CSV reconstruction fidelity or systematically distinguish between different types of reconstruction errors, such as over-segmentation or collapse of independent breakpoints. Here we present Verix, a comprehensive toolkit designed for the fine-grained evaluation and integration of CSVs. Verixintroduces granular diagnostic metrics that enable researchers to thoroughly characterize CSV predictions and stratify performance based on breakpoint sensitivity, precision, and structural integrity. In addition to pairwise callset-to-truthset comparisons, Verixalso provides an intra- and inter-callset harmonization module for generating consensus calls for a single tool’s output or across disparate discovery pipelines. As such, Verixprovides the infrastructure needed to rigorously evaluate and reconcile CSV calls, accelerating the standardization of CSV discovery in both research and clinical settings. Availability and implementation Verixis available under the MIT license at https://github.com/PopicLab/verix and https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22998063

all_papers.llm_research_question_zh: 摘要：复杂结构变异是一类具有重要意义但目前研究尚不充分的、大规模发生的基因组重排类型。
llm_highlights_zh: 要发现这些CSV事件，不仅需要准确检测出各个断裂点，还需要将这些断裂点组装成一个结构清晰、完整的CSV事件。
然而，目前CSV方法的开发仍受到诊断工具局限性的影响：现有的SV评估框架都是为单区间或单节点的SV设计的，它们无法量化多断点CSV重建的准确性，也无法系统地区分各种类型的重建错误，例如过度分割或独立断点的丢失等。
在这里，我们向您介绍 Verix——这一专为 CSV 文件的精细评估与集成而设计的综合性工具包。
all_papers.llm_rss_summary_zh:
摘要：复杂结构变异是一类具有重要研究价值但目前尚未得到充分研究的基因组大规模重排类型。要发现这类变异，不仅需要准确检测各个断裂点，还需要将这些断裂点重新组装成具有明确结构的完整变异事件。然而，当前用于分析这类变异的方法发展仍受到技术局限性的制约——现有的评估框架主要针对单间隔或单连接点的结构变异设计，无法量化多断裂点变异的重建准确性，也无法系统地区分各种类型的重建错误（如过度分割或独立断裂点的合并）。我们开发的Verix工具包为这类变异的精细评估与整合提供了有力支持。该工具引入了详细的诊断指标，使研究人员能够全面分析变异预测结果的准确性，并根据断裂点的敏感性、精确度及结构完整性对结果进行分类评估。除了支持成对比对功能外，Verix还提供了内部及跨不同检测流程的协调模块，可用于生成统一、可靠的变异鉴定结果。因此，Verix为规范这类变异的研究与临床应用奠定了重要基础。
